aboutHeading: A Decade of Service in Brunswick
aboutText: With over 10 years of experience, Brunswick Electrical Services has been the trusted choice for electricians in Brunswick and surrounding suburbs. Our licensed team brings over a decade of hands-on experience, specializing in both residential and commercial electrical work. We are committed to delivering reliable, safe, and efficient solutions tailored to the needs of Brunswick homes and businesses.
servicesText: We offer a full range of electrical services to meet the needs of Brunswick residents and businesses. Whether it's a quick fix or a major installation, our skilled electricians are equipped to handle it all efficiently and safely.

services.title: Residential Wiring & Repairs
services.desc: We handle all home electrical issues, from faulty outlets to complete rewiring, ensuring your family's safety.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Installations
services.desc: Expert wiring and setup for offices, shops, and warehouses across Brunswick, tailored to your business needs.

services.title: Safety Inspections & Compliance
services.desc: Thorough electrical safety checks to keep your property compliant and secure, with detailed reports provided.

services.title: Lighting Design & Installation
services.desc: Enhance your space with energy-efficient lighting solutions, from LED upgrades to custom designs for homes and businesses.

services.title: Power Point & Switch Installations
services.desc: Additional power points or smart switches installed professionally, adding convenience and functionality to your property.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Services
services.desc: 24/7 emergency callouts for urgent electrical faults, providing prompt and reliable solutions when you need them most.
